[File: /home/airic/repos/apogee/internal/config/config.go, 3848 lines total, showing lines 3046-3120]
// The environment and flag layers
//
// The only three keys — server, mode, bypass — that carry all four layers
// (flag > env > file > default) are read here, in this order-derived group.
// They are the startup posture keys: which upstream, at what autonomy, in what
// Reaction posture. Everything else is file-or-default only.
const (
	EnvServer = "APOGEE_SERVER"
	EnvMode   = "APOGEE_MODE"
	EnvBypass = "APOGEE_BYPASS"
)

// configKeyAccessors is the table of keys whose file layer exists. [ResolveOptions] applies
// the four layers in precedence order onto [Options]; this table binds the registry row for
// each key to the accessor that carries its file layer, and the accessor's presence here is
// what makes the key's file layer exist at all. The four layers are:
//
//  1. the file pass (applyFile) writes every key of the file onto the Options;
//  2. the flag pass (applyFlags) overwrites server, mode and bypass when the flag was set;
//  3. the env pass (applyEnv) overwrites server, mode and bypass when the variable is
//     non-empty, landing AFTER flags; and the env layer of a key whose flag pass already
//     wrote it is skipped (the flag wins).
//  4. the default pass writes whatever is still zero.
//
// The order makes the precedence chain: flag > env > file > default. Nothing outside this file
// re-implements the rule.
func configKeyAccessors(configKeys []string) []keyAccessor { ... }
```

This directly confirms claim 17's "only three keys carry all four layers".

Let me read more[File: /home/airic/repos/apogee/internal/config/config.go, 3848 lines total, showing lines 3162-3220]
func ResolveOptions(opts *Options, srcs ...func(*Options) error) error {
	// The file layer first, then flags, then env, then defaults — applying the sources in this
	// order IS the precedence rule (flag > env > file > default): each layer overwrites what the
	// lower-priority one wrote.
	for _, src := range srcs {
		if err := src(opts); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// applyFile applies the file pass: every key of the parsed file onto the Options. ...
func applyFile(opts *Options, fc *fileConfig) error { ... }

// applyFlags ...
func applyFlags(opts *Options, flags FlagSet) error {...}

// applyEnv ...
func applyEnv(opts *Options, getenv func(string) string) error {...}

// applyDefaults computes the default pass: every field Options carries that is still zero takes
// its default. ...

// overrideSources reports which higher-precedence source beat the config file for each key this
// run, keyed by registry path. ...

// flagNames returns the THREE startup keys' flag names, from the same registry rows the
// variables above are read off, so the env and the flag cannot disagree about which key is which
// — a `server:` flag that wrote APOGEE_SERVER would not be the fourth layer of server:, it would
// be the second.
func flagNames() map[string]string { ... }

// Source markers for /settings
//
// Source is the marker ...
type Source string

const (
	SourceFlag   Source = "flag"
	SourceEnv    Source = "env"
	SourceFile   Source = "file"
	SourceDefault Source = "default"
)
```
